instruction: My sister asked me to buy something for her from amazon. But I totally forgot to place the order. She sent me the money for it on venmo. Place the necessary amazon order for my home address and add a "Thanks!" comment on their venmo payment.
notes: Sister is identified via phone.search_contacts(relationship=sister); her venmo payment (received, description naming the amazon item) is found via venmo.show_transactions(user_email). The product name learned from the transaction description becomes the amazon.search_products query. The cart is cleared first so the placed order contains exactly one item with quantity 1 (evaluation ignores CartEntry changes). The home address id is chosen on amazon.show_addresses by matching supervisor.show_addresses; amazon addresses are only read, never updated or deleted. Static facts (sent-by, transaction-mentions, product-matches, is-home-address) encode the lookup relations the agent discovers at runtime. Tokens are tied to apps via token-for to keep logins unambiguous. supervisor-complete-task takes the task records as parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; the task asks no question so complete_task is called without an answer.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-1 home-address amazon-token product-for-sister quantity-1 order-1)
(supervisor-complete-task order-1 product-for-sister quantity-1 home-address sister-transaction comment-thanks)
